title: Introduce residency policy linter and KMS proofing middleware
author: Nadia Patel
release_notes: Adds a residency policy linter to validate RBAC/KMS residency constraints at CI time and a runtime middleware that attaches KMS-proof assertions to audit events. Rollout behind feature flag 'residency_linter_v1' with staged canary.
description:
Context: Customers and compliance teams requested stricter guardrails for tenant data residency and key usage. Current policy-compiler discovers residency rules at runtime but we had gaps: (1) developer-surface validation in CI, and (2) non-deterministic KMS provenance attached to audit records when requests are proxied.
This PR adds two components: a residency policy linter (CI-time) that flags misconfigured RBAC v2 bindings and KMS region mismatches, and a lightweight KMS-proofing middleware that attaches deterministic provenance headers and structured audit events for downstream collectors.
Motivation: catch misconfigurations earlier, improve non-repudiation for KMS calls, and make audit trails actionable for compliance reviews.
Changes made:
- New tool: policy/compiler/linter/residency_linter.go (public CLI and CI plugin) — validates: tenant-scoped role bindings, CMK region tags, and route-level residency allowlists.
- Runtime middleware: serving/middleware/kms_proofing.go — attaches X-KMS-Proof and injects residency.audit.v1 events into the audit pipeline when a request uses a customer CMK.
- Audit enrichment: audit/transformers/residency_event.go — serializes proof + matching policy fingerprint and includes provenance claims.
- Tests: integration-tests/residency_linter_test.py and unit tests under policy/compiler/linter/*.go.
- Docs: docs/security/residency-linter.md with usage, CI integration, and examples of failure messages.
- Helm: charts/redwood-helm/templates/residency-config.yaml adds feature flag and rollout knobs.
Rollout plan: feature flag residency_linter_v1 default off. Staged rollout: staging -> 5% canary in us-east-1 -> 25% -> global.
CI integration: linter run added to pre-merge job for redwood repo (lint-residency).
